name: home
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Generate one high-fidelity DESKTOP WEBSITE HOMEPAGE FIRST VIEWPORT, horizontal 1536 by 1024, no device frame, no collage. This is the approved Oedipus Rex school literary guide: contemporary literary exhibition of Greek tragedy. Render actual clean UI, readable realistic text.

Header: wide ivory band with small serif wordmark OEDIPUS REX at left, horizontal navigation Home Story Characters Analysis Passages Activities About at right; Home indicated with thin burgundy underline. Use 72px outside margins, thin rule under header.
Main hero immediately below header: asymmetric split in one open 1200px-wide composition. Left half has very large two-line headline "Oedipus Rex" with subtitle "A search for truth." italic burgundy; then readable sentence "A king. A city in crisis. A search that changes everything." Primary lightly rounded burgundy rectangle "Explore the story" and secondary underlined "Meet the characters", plenty of clear breathing room. Right half uses the supplied reference image as the actual artwork field: Oedipus facing winged Greek Sphinx, ivory and bronze incised figures on solid charcoal, framed as a clean 3:2 rectangular museum illustration. No text on illustration. Beneath small caption "A modern interpretation of Oedipus and the Sphinx."
Under hero, one thin-rule metadata band with four columns Author Sophocles; Form Greek tragedy; Setting Thebes; Translation F. Storr. Then beginning of an editorial introduction section with heading "An investigation into the self" and a readable paragraph. Main title and button remain clearly visible at small laptop height. Do not invent stats, badges, quotations or student details.
